name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.157: The stamp above the refresh button reads "Manually refreshed <time>" instead of
  "Refreshed <time>" - it is written by that button and nothing else, so the label now says so.
  The second page script carried its own status loader that still wrote the line with a SERVER
  timestamp labelled "Last checked"; that writer is gone, so the one-writer rule holds in both
  files. A check fails the build if either file writes the stamp again.
